title: JANUS Engine — dedicated research-branch manifest
purpose: Structured index for JANUS Engine architecture, simulations, literature crawls and staged validation without prematurely merging research conclusions into main.

branching_policy.rule: Existing canonical JANUS Engine records remain inherited at data/ paths; branch-specific gates, simulations and research live under projects/janus-engine/.

MODE_A_DIRECT_GILL_PEMFC.flow: water -> POMS artificial gill -> low-pO2 recirculating cathode gas -> PEMFC -> electricity -> auxiliaries
MODE_A_DIRECT_GILL_PEMFC.reason: avoids bulk O2/N2 separation, N2 service and LOX during first ignition

MODE_B_INTEGRATED_VRU_AKS.flow: dissolved-gas extraction -> conditioning -> O2/N2 separation -> O2 use/storage + N2 cooling/regeneration/inert cascade -> optional cryogenic branch

latest_findings.dominant_transport_lesson: water-side mass transfer and flow distribution dominate before intrinsic POMS permeance; condensation can suppress effective permeance
latest_findings.flat_stack_crown_correction: At the published 3 m2 per approximately 0.3 m cube packing density, the current 700 mm OD x 500 mm annular crown carries about 21.2 m2 POMS flat-stack area, not 423.5 m2.
latest_findings.startup_lesson: self-drive is a transient state transition. Direct gill/PEMFC gradient establishment is naturally hours-scale in the published inventory screen; full VRU/AKS can take much longer while cyclic sorbents and thermal inventories stabilize.
latest_findings.user_legacy_reference: Historical integrated air-separation startup experience of roughly one to four days is retained as plant-specific operational evidence, not a universal JANUS constant.

current_project_state.dominant_boss: Simultaneously achieve POMS O2 flux, homogeneous water renewal, condensation control and a single-digit/low-tens-of-watts auxiliary budget in a realizable cassette.

next_actions: Design a small sectorized POMS cassette with distributed water headers and 4 mm-class water / 3 mm-class gas channels as the first literature-anchored geometry.
Measure J_O2, DeltaP, gas-loop fan power, humidity/condensate and active-flow utilization through startup and sustained hold.
Use a starter/buffer source until FLUX_LOCK and LOAD_TRANSFER; do not count starter energy as steady-state generation.
Only scale the validated cassette toward the ~21.2 m2 crown after measured oxygen and energy balances close.
